title.narrative: Assistance médicale d'urgence au nouvel afflux de déplacés lié à la crise soudanaise dans la province du Wadi Fira

description.narrative: The proposed project is part of the rapid response to the recent influx of Sudanese refugees in Wadi Fira province. It aims to provide emergency medical assistance to 38,000 people (refugees and host communities) which will also contribute to achieving one of the 3 WHO Triple Billion Global Goals which is: 1 billion additional people better protected from health emergencies. The project aims to reduce mortality and morbidity due to this influx through the following axes:- Provision of emergency medical equipment and essential medicines to health facilities. - Support for health personnel for equitable and rapid access of populations to emergency primary health care, including capacity building of community health workers for better involvement and awareness raising of communities. - Medical support (including psychological) to survivors of sexual violence and other forms of gender-based violence and provision of psychological first aid to people suffering from serious mental disorders in communities and institutions. - Support for referral to secondary health care and support for the provision of surgical and psychiatric services. The project will serve as a catalyst for additional mobilization of resources to support the government in its efforts to respond to the many humanitarian and health events facing the country.
